io_driver_functions.notes: Flash chip-ID read: writes 0xAA/0x55/0x90 unlock+ID-entry sequence to the two Flash command-latch addresses in the 0x0E000000 window, busy-waits, reads a 2-byte manufacturer/device ID via func_0x080072f8, then writes 0xAA/0x55/0xF0 to exit ID mode. Calls FUN_08006ac0 (64-byte buffer copy) as a helper. Ends in an unresolved indirect jump-table call (UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE).

Flash device-parameter table lookup / bank initializer. Calls FUN_08006878 to get the chip ID, linear-scans a device-parameter array comparing a 2-byte ID field at record offset 0x28, copies 5 chip-geometry fields (sector size/bank count/timing) into fixed RAM globals on match or at the terminating record. Zero resolvable direct callers in ghidra/callgraph.json or by grep of ghidra/decompiled.c; only reachable via an unresolved indirect jump-table call. This is generic AGB SDK flash-driver initialization, not game-specific save logic.

Flash payload write primitive. Sets a busy/mode flag, stages a block into a local buffer, computes a bank-shifted address inside the 0x0E000000 window from param_1/param_2 and a shift byte, and hands it plus param_3/param_4 and the staging buffer to the unresolved thunk func_0x080072f0 for actual byte programming. Zero resolvable direct callers in ghidra/callgraph.json or by grep of ghidra/decompiled.c; only reachable via an unresolved indirect jump-table call. The game-specific save-struct serialization and the caller that decides what/when to flush are not present in this workspace's trace window.
